description: This Java class implements the StaffReadPlatformService interface, providing methods to retrieve staff data from a database within the Apache Fineract microfinance platform. It includes methods for fetching individual staff records, lists of staff based on criteria, and hierarchical staff data, utilizing JDBC templates and custom mappers. The class also handles security context integration to ensure appropriate data visibility and includes internal helper classes for mapping database result sets to StaffData objects.

classes.name: StaffMapper
classes.description: Maps SQL ResultSet rows to StaffData objects with staff info from the basic staff table.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Returns the SQL schema string for querying staff data.

methods.name: mapRow
methods.description: Maps a row from ResultSet to StaffData object.

classes.name: StaffInOfficeHierarchyMapper
classes.description: Maps SQL ResultSet rows to StaffData objects including hierarchy-based office info.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Generates the SQL query string based on whether only loan officers are to be included.

methods.name: mapRow
methods.description: Maps a row to a StaffData object, including hierarchy-based data.

classes.name: StaffLookupMapper
classes.description: Provides a lightweight mapping for staff lookup by ID and display name.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Returns the SQL string for the lookup schema.

methods.name: mapRow
methods.description: Maps a result set row to StaffData with id and displayName.

methods.name: retrieveAllLoanOfficersInOfficeById
methods.description: Retrieves all staff who are loan officers in a specific office.

methods.name: retrieveAllStaffForDropdown
methods.description: Retrieves staff for dropdown selections, considering user security context.

methods.name: retrieveStaff
methods.description: Retrieves a specific staff member by ID, ensuring hierarchy-based access control.

methods.name: retrieveAllStaff
methods.description: Retrieves all staff matching criteria for a given office, with optional filters for loan officers and status.

methods.name: retrieveAllStaffInOfficeAndItsParentOfficeHierarchy
methods.description: Retrieves staff within an office hierarchy, optionally filtering for loan officers only.

methods.name: hasAssociatedItems
methods.description: Checks if a staff member has associated client, group, loan, or savings accounts.
